description: Technical domain for CI report generation, workflow and release automation, and custom-node CI utilities. It supports repository delivery rather than frontend product behavior.

characterizationScenarios.name: Reports preserve artifact status and section output
Workflow selection preserves PR identity, pagination and pending reruns through actual action wiring
Custom-node CI preserves quarantine and result handling

compatibilityPromises: Inventory preserves existing CLI entry points, package exports and artifact formats without introducing import restrictions.
